image_description: A close-up view of a large grey whale surfacing next to a small blue boat. The whale's head and upper back are visible, showing characteristic mottled grey skin with white barnacle patches. The water is choppy, and there is some text overlay at the bottom.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape appears somewhat consistent with a baleen whale, but the resolution is too low to verify the 'arched rostrum' or specifically identify 'two blowholes'. The angle obscures the top of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin clearly exhibits the mottled grey pattern with distinct white callosities/barnacle patches typical of grey whales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image only shows the head and immediate shoulder area. The posterior back where dorsal knuckles would be located is not visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the anterior portion of the whale is visible; the full spindle shape cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the head checkpoint, the visible skin texture matches the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed or submerged; baleen plates are internal and not visible in this external shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are located further down the body and are not visible in this crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin surface shows the expected roughness and raised white callosities.
